text:
rachael: quick note — discovered another streaming resume edge in the sample app that mixes auth refresh + chunk coalescing. When tokens expire during a long-lived SSE we do an auth refresh and reconnect using Last-Event-ID. If the proxy coalesces frames mid-event the SDK sometimes emits the last event twice after resume.

pritam: can you paste a minimal repro and the raw bytes? Does this happen in browser and node?

rachael: repro: browser + node + mobile webview. Server sequence: id:5000 -> data:{"t":"A"}, id:5001 -> data:{"t":"B"}. Proxy coalesces so the client read returns both events in one buffer "data...A
data...B
" with only a single trailing CRLF. If auth expires after that read and we close+refresh+reconnect with Last-Event-ID:5000 server resends 5000 and we get A again.

yuki: is the SDK preserving the `id` internally and exposing it? Also what does our auth retry code do — does it abort mid-read?

rachael: auth code cancels the existing request and opens a new one with Last-Event-ID header. SDK currently emits events as soon as they parse; it has no dedupe across reconnects. So dupes slip through.

pritam: suggested fixes for parity/DX: (1) SDK-level dedupe by `id` with small memory bound (ring buffer or LRU), (2) expose `id` on emitted events so apps can also de-dupe if they want, (3) add a tolerant newline parsing mode with a short flush timer to avoid waiting for strict double-newline in coalesced cases.

yuki: about auth flow: prefer not to abort mid-chunk if possible. Could we instead attempt auth refresh in parallel and only recreate the connection if the server actually rejects subsequent requests? But that adds complexity. In any case, dedupe handles the symptom.

edge-bot: alert: sample-app staging saw 1.1% increase in SSE reconnects for 2026-04-10T03:21:00Z.

pritam: implementation details: dedupe table of last N ids (default 1024) with TTL (e.g., 10m) to limit memory. On reconnect, when parsing events skip any id already seen. Emit a metric `sse.duplicate_skipped` and an event log when skipping. Make dedupe opt-in `sse.dedupeById=true` to avoid breaking strict semantics.

yuki: parsing strategy: default strict (no change). Add `sse.partialFlushMs` default 0. If >0 and parser sees a single LF, start a short timer (e.g., 30-50ms) and flush partial event if no additional bytes arrive. That reduces delivery latency for coalesced frames.

rachael: also consider a protective debounce in auth code: if auth refresh happens within X ms of a recent socket read, delay abort briefly so we don't replicate an event that just arrived. Tricky but could help.

pritam: test strategy: add unit tests for parser with inputs that split JSON mid-field, combine multiple events in one buffer, and interleave id headers. Add integration test harness using docker-compose with nginx/haproxy that forces coalescing and splits, plus a scripted auth refresh to force reconnect. Add the E2E to SDK CI.

yuki: docs: update quickstart streaming to document `Last-Event-ID` semantics and recommended server settings (disable buffering / use flush) and show the SDK flags for dedupe and partialFlushMs. Provide a minimal nginx config that reproduces the issue for debugging.

edge-bot: action items created: SDKS-1990 (Node dedupe + parser), SDKS-1991 (Go parity), SDKS-1992 (browser/webview docs).

rachael: short-term workaround for users: include a `seq` field in payload JSON and dedupe in app, or set server to immediate flush on SSE endpoints. We'll add a line in the quickstart to mention this.

ci-bot: CI note: adding the nginx-based E2E will increase CI runtime; propose making it an on-demand job in a separate pipeline first.

pritam: agreed. We'll add it as an optional E2E gate initially and enable it in main SDK CI after we confirm stability.

yuki: one more: make sure the SDK exposes the raw `id` and `lastEventId` so higher-level frameworks (that do strict ordering) can compose their own resume/dedupe strategies.

rachael: I'll open a PR with a tiny example that reproduces the auth+coalesce case and a small README showing how to run with nginx. Linking here when ready.

edge-bot: CI queued for branch fix/sse-dedupe (tests running).

pritam: once PRs land let's add an E2E assertion: simulate auth expiry during stream, reconnect, assert no duplicate logical tokens observed when `sse.dedupeById=true`. That will prevent regressions.

rachael: thanks team — this should clear up a lot of onboarding pain where new users see the quickstart replay the first token after a refresh.
